_about: Placement types of the 'dressing' group (sky, lights, weather, particles, animated props). Decoded from the Xbox default.xbe (parsemap_create_dynamic_objects 0xa4bc0) and checked against the placements in all 32 level bundles. level_tag key k = dword at 0x2c + 4*k. All Create functions are __cdecl with the stack args shown. Object Euler rotation = View_RotTransMatrix 0xd92e0 (control_create_object with quat NULL); see docs/level/objects-dressing.md. Spec: docs/level/objects-dressing.md
_euler_objects: View_RotTransMatrix(rot): m0=cz*cy m1=sz m2=-cz*sy | m4=sy*sx-sz*cy*cx m5=cz*cx m6=cy*sx+sz*sy*cx | m8=sy*cx+sz*cy*sx m9=-cz*sx m10=cy*cx-sz*sy*sx | m12..14=pos (row vectors: right, up, dir, pos)
_euler_sky: RotMatrix(rot) 0xd6560: m0=cz*cy m4=-sz*cy m8=sy | m1=sz*cx+cz*sy*sx m5=cz*cx-sy*sx*sz m9=-cy*sx | m2=sz*sx-sy*cx*cz m6=cz*sx+sy*cx*sz m10=cy*cx
_glist_flags: celglist applyFlagsToObject (entity +0x08), copied into obj effectFlags by most Create functions: 0x1 translucent (alpha list), 0x4 random +-5% scale jitter, 0x8 camera-facing billboard (roll = rot.z), 0x10 hidden, 0x2000 draw in the late (glare) list, 0x8000 never drawn. In View_DrawSky only: 0x2 = centred on the camera, 0x8 = camera rotation.

visual.detail: Invisible precipitation volume: world AABB = pos + [glist bbMin, bbMax] (rotation ignored, RainBox_Clip 0xa3ab0). Rain/snow/bubbles (type from the level's Env key 0) only spawn inside rain boxes. Glists are 'Rainbox*'/'Effect_Snow_*' boxes, 0 or 12 tris, flag 0x30/0x10 hidden or no mesh - do not draw the glist.

252.name: Corona

visual.detail: Glist is a 2-tri glow quad (corona_small, corona1, Corona_Glow2, Window_corona...) with flags 0x2d/0x229 = translucent + billboard (+0x4 jitter). Drawn camera-facing at pos with the glist's own texture, alpha fades in 16/frame while the camera has line of sight (Corona_Update 0xa3eb0), drawn in the late glare list. Export: the glist quad as a billboard (track-to-camera), additive/alpha material.

252.transform: pos; rot ignored when billboarded (only rot.z roll if nonzero)

fields.name: appearSwitch
fields.note: u16. Nonzero: object starts hidden (effectFlags |= 0x30) until switch_channels[k0] is set, then its glist flags are restored. Seen 0,9..140

fields.name: disappearSwitch
fields.note: u16. When set: k3==0 -> object deleted; k3!=0 -> hidden while set, shown while clear. Seen 0,1,43..140

fields.name: fadeDistance
fields.note: s16. Nonzero: alpha = clamp((dist/k2 - 0.5)*2)*255 when the camera is closer than k2 (fades out as you approach; used by volumetric light shafts). Seen 0,9,13

fields.name: toggleMode
fields.note: byte. See key 1. Seen 0,1

visual.detail: Draws the placement glist (CONSOLE_Camera_*, OBJECT_RopeBarrier, endleveldoor, pallet stacks, *_volumetric light shafts (flags 0x221 translucent), WallHug blockers (flag 0x10 hidden)). Initially hidden when key 0 != 0.

42.name: SkyObject
42.call: View_AddSkyObj(u16 k0, celglist, &pos, &rot, NULL, byte k1, u16 k2, u16 k3, byte k4)

fields.name: skySlot
fields.note: u16 slot 0..20 (>=21 ignored). A later placement with the same slot (and same key 1) replaces the earlier one. Seen 0..18

fields.name: isLightningFlash
fields.note: byte. 0: normal sky glist. 1: glist is the flash image, drawn only during random lightning flashes (also drives Lightning bolts and thunder SFX). Seen 0,1 (Thunderhead)

fields.name: flashIntervalMax
fields.note: u16 seconds; next flash after Rand(k2*60) frames. Only with k1=1. Seen 24,30

fields.name: flashDuration
fields.note: u16 frames of flicker per flash. Seen 5,10

fields.name: drawPass
fields.note: byte. 1 = drawn first, before all objects (distant backdrop: mountains, towers); 0 = drawn after the opaque object list (skybox, moon, skyline). Seen 0,1

visual.detail: View_DrawSky 0xd9d60, unlit, no fog. Glist flag 0x2 set (skyboxes, moon, starfield: flags 0x222/0x22/0x23): drawn centred on the CAMERA position - place at world origin / follow camera. Flag 0x2 clear (mountains, Sky_Tower*, skyline buildings: 0x20/0x0): drawn at the placement pos (mostly 0,0,0 with the mesh modelled in world coordinates). Rotation = RotMatrix(rot) (sky Euler, NOT the object Euler) unless glist flag 0x8 (camera rotation). SpaceStationD (0x0700001b) spins the sky about X at 1/1440 rad per frame.

42.transform: rot via RotMatrix 0xd6560; pos only when glist flag 0x2 is clear; the camera position otherwise

242.name: Emitter
242.call: mtx = Quat_QuatToMat(quat); mtx.pos = pos; Emitter_CreatePlist(&mtx, lvl) -> Emitter_Create 0x68290(hash k0, &pos, &up(mtx row1), duration, k2, k3, k4, k5/60)

fields.name: particleConfig
fields.note: Always 0x0c000004 in the data (orange sparks). Configs come from block 0x30 of the shared FX pack 0100002e (in every bundle).

fields.name: duration
fields.note: 0 = emit forever; 1 = one burst (each particle once); N = emit for N/60 s. Always 0 in the data

fields.name: enableSwitch
fields.note: Nonzero: emits only while switch_channels[k2] is set. Seen 0,78..201

fields.name: disableSwitch
fields.note: Nonzero: emits only while switch_channels[k3] is clear. Always 0

fields.name: aliveSwitchOut
fields.note: Set to 1 each frame while any particle is alive. Seen 0,141

fields.name: pulsePeriod
fields.note: k5/60 = P seconds; nonzero: emits for P/2 s, pauses P s, repeat. Seen 60..600

visual.detail: Placement glist 'ParticleEmmiter' is NOT drawn. Point-sprite particle system at pos; emission axis = up row of the placement QUATERNION (x,y,z,w) - e.g. q=(1,0,0,0) emits straight down. Config 0x0c000004: 20 particles max, 4 new per frame, texture 0x03000082, size 0.173, life 0.667 s (+-rand 0.017), speed 1+-2, pitch 0+-pi/2 (hemisphere about the axis), yaw random, gravity 0.612*9.8, colour (255,151,0,a255) -> (0,0,0,255) over life.

fields.name: radius
fields.note: s16 units; rings spawn at pos + uniform(-k0..k0) in x and z. Seen 1..7 (0 with k1 0 -> 1)

fields.name: meanInterval
fields.note: s16 frames at 60 Hz; each frame a ring spawns with probability 1/k1. Seen 1,2,10,30 (both 0 -> 30)

visual.detail: Invisible generator (glist 'RIPPLE_GEN', 0 tris). Spawns expanding water-ring gas objects using entity 0x02000129 'watereffect' at pos.y, scale 0.05..0.1, grey 127, fading. Export as an empty/marker or a small ring-particle system on the water surface.

fields.name: unknown_2
fields.note: u16 copied to ladder data +2. Always 0 in the data. Key 0 is never read (seen 0,2).

visual.detail: Draws the placement glist (Ladder, Ladder_small, OBJECT_Ladder...; effectFlags not copied from the glist, so drawn opaque). Some ladder glists have 0 tris (the rungs are in the static world); the glist bbox is the climb volume (Controls_StraddleTest, PlayerCollLadder 0xae930).

fields.name: unused
fields.note: never read by RB_Create; always 0

fields.name: mode
fields.note: RB_Init: 0 = free body with gravity; nonzero = hanging/pendulum body (no gravity, swings about the object origin); 3 = stiffer. Always 1 in the data

fields.name: hasLight
fields.note: byte; mode!=0 bodies create a psiLight that follows them - psiLight_Create returns 0 on Xbox, so no effect there. Seen 0,1

fields.name: collisionSfx
fields.note: SFX id, 0 -> 0xffff none. Always 65535

visual.detail: Draws the placement glist (rb_redlamp, rb_greenlamp, kitchen-panswing*, bucketswing, OBJECT_WellBucket, concrete blocks). Hanging lamps/pans are modelled below their origin (bbox max y = 0): the origin is the pivot. Rest pose = placement transform.

223.name: Env

fields.name: dropType
fields.note: byte -> InitDrops: 0 snow (texture 0x03000045 point sprites, 4096 flakes), 1 rain (entity 0x02000290 'Raindrop' meshes, 64 drops, 128 in Tower A-C), 2 bubbles rising (texture 0x03000087, 2048), 255 none. Also: 0 enables breath puffs. Seen 0,1,2,255

fields.name: unknown_40
fields.note: byte, stored only when k0==0. Seen 0,1

fields.name: unknown_42
fields.note: byte. Seen 4,10

fields.name: windStrength
fields.note: *0.1 -> wind speed (gusting, Env_Update); wind direction = forward row of RotMatrix(rot). Seen 0,6,10

fields.name: unknown_3c
fields.note: byte; always 0

fields.name: unknown_3d
fields.note: byte; always 0

fields.name: unknown_3e
fields.note: byte; always 0

fields.name: unknown_f30
fields.note: -> float; always 0

fields.name: unknown_f34
fields.note: -> float; always 0

fields.name: hasSun
fields.note: Seen 0,1 (PowerStation A1/A2)

fields.name: sunElevationDeg
fields.note: Seen 25,19. SunVector = 1000*(sin a*cos e, -sin e, cos a*cos e) (a=k10 deg, e=k11 deg) points FROM the sun; the sun is at camera - SunVector (lens flare, HUD_UpdateLensFlarePane)

visual.detail: Invisible marker (Rain_generator, SNOW_gen, Bubble_gen, Environment, Weather; hidden flags). Attaches an environment record to the room (cel) containing pos (first one per cel wins); the LAST Env created sets the level-wide drop type. Export: level properties (precipitation type, wind vector, optional sun = glTF directional light along SunVector).

223.transform: pos selects the cel; rot = wind direction (RotMatrix)

fields.name: skin
fields.note: AnimObjectNew(obj, k0). Always 0x05000003 (tree skin, present in bundles 07000001-04)

fields.name: animScript
fields.note: AnimScriptAdd; 0x0600008c is swapped for 0x0600008d with 50% chance; looped with a random start frame (except in level 0x07000043). Always 0x0600008c

visual.detail: Animated (swaying) tree: skin 0x05000003 posed by script 0x0600008c/8d. The placement glist 'Tree' is NOT used. Export as the skinned model at pos/rot (bind pose or first frame).

113.name: Rotor
113.call: rotor_init(&pos, &rot, celglist, 0, byte k0, byte k1)

fields.name: unused
fields.note: passed as arg 4 but never read. Seen 0

fields.name: switchChannel
fields.note: byte; nonzero: spins only while switch_channels[k1] == 0 (polarity byte never set). Never present in the data -> always spins

visual.detail: Draws the placement glist (fans, office_N_hologram, rotating blades). Spin: every frame rotation += rot * (60/fps), i.e. the Euler rates are rot radians per 1/60 s (rot.y 0.035 -> 2.1 rad/s yaw; fanblades rot.x 0.349 -> 20.9 rad/s). rot is also the initial orientation.

113.transform: pos + rot (object Euler, rot = start angles AND angular velocity per 1/60 s)

fields.name: unknown_38
fields.note: stored at data+0x38, not read by update. Always 0

fields.name: group
fields.note: u16. Points with the same group are joined: a new point pairs with an earlier one of the same group and owns an 8-segment bolt between them. Seen 1,2

fields.name: unknown_3e
fields.note: u16; always 0

visual.detail: Invisible bolt end point (glist 'Lightning1' not drawn). During sky lightning flashes (SkyObject k1=1) a jagged bolt of entity 0x0200032c 'Lightning' is drawn between paired points. Only in HendersonA (0x07000001). Export: empties, optionally a polyline between group members.

62.name: Wire

fields.name: wireType
fields.note: u16 at data+0: 0 hand-over-hand wire, 1 inactive, 2 zipline (slide down). Seen 0,2

fields.name: unknown_4
fields.note: u16; always 0

fields.name: onWireSwitch
fields.note: u16; set while the player is on the wire (Player_Wire 0xafb50). Always 0

visual.detail: Draws the placement glist (Wire, Wire_Cable, Zipline*: 8-60 tris). The usable line runs through the object centre along direction (spherical: yaw rot.y+pi/2, pitch rot.z), half length = object radius - 2.

62.transform: pos + (rot.x, rot.y, -rot.z) with the object Euler - Z IS NEGATED

78.name: Light
78.call: Light_Create(&pos, r=k1, g=k2, b=k3, radius=(float)(u32)k0, switch=k4, -1, 0, 1.0, k5, k6, k7, k8)  (no glist)

fields.name: radius
fields.note: range in units (m): affects objects within radius (+ object radius); d3dSetLight gets 1/radius. Seen 6,8

fields.name: red
fields.note: byte 0..255 (d3d colour = byte/256). Seen 127,255

fields.name: switchChannel
fields.note: u16; nonzero: on/off follows switch_channels[k4]. Always 0 (always on)

fields.name: flickerDuration
fields.note: u16 frames; 0 = no flicker. Always 0

fields.name: flickerGap
fields.note: u16 frames steady between flickers (random k6/2..). Always 0

fields.name: flickerMask
fields.note: u16; on when (frame & mask) == mask during a flicker. Always 1

fields.name: flickerSfx
fields.note: SFX played at each flicker start; 0 -> 0xffff none. 65535 or absent

visual.detail: Point light (type 0) -> KHR_lights_punctual point: color = (k1,k2,k3)/255, range = k0. Placement glist 'oLightPoint' is only an editor marker (not drawn). Only 5 placements (HendersonA). Most of a level's lights are the map's block 0x26 'ambient radiators' (same light_tag, see the doc). In game these lights only light objects/characters whose effectFlags has 0x80; the world mesh is prelit.

fields.name: unknown_0
fields.note: u16 data+0. Seen 0,2

fields.name: unknown_2
fields.note: u16 data+2. Seen 1,3

fields.name: unknown_4
fields.note: u16 data+4. Always 0

fields.name: unknown_6
fields.note: u16 data+6. Always 113 (same channel as the WallHug_Blocker DynamicObjects' key 1 - probably a switch)

visual.detail: Invisible wall-hug (ledge creep) strip: glist 'Wall Hug *' has 0 tris, flags 0x50 (hidden), flat bbox (zero depth). The creep line runs through the object centre along local X (yaw rot.y+pi/2), half length = object radius (Player_CollCreepWall 0xaeda0).

Invisible generator (glist 'Leaf_emmit', 0 tris, flags 0x30). About every 0.5 s spawns one falling leaf (entity 0x020002ca 'Leaf') at a random point in a cube of half-size = object radius around pos, drifting along rot.y (sin, cos).

212.name: Cloud

fields.name: heightAboveCamera
fields.note: int; layer y = camera y + k0 (drawn in the sky pass), player y + k0 in update. Seen 8

fields.name: scrollX
fields.note: *0.001 units per 1/60 s. Seen 15

fields.name: scrollZ
fields.note: *0.001 units per 1/60 s. Seen 2

fields.name: wrapPeriod
fields.note: int; x/z offsets wrap modulo k3 units. Seen 100

fields.name: skySlot
fields.note: sky slot (registered as a sky object, draw pass 1). Seen 3

visual.detail: Cloud layer plane (glist 'CloudLayerXR9', 400x400, 32 tris) that follows the player: x/z = player + scrolling offset, y = camera y + k0; drawn with the object's rot and scale in the sky pass. Only in CastleCourtyard (0x07000006). Export: the glist at (pos.x, typical ground height + k0, pos.z) or at the origin + k0.

212.transform: rot used; pos replaced at runtime (player-relative)

fields.name: smokeEnable
fields.note: u16; nonzero: when the light is out, emits spark/smoke gas (entities 0x020002d1..d5 Sparkler_1..5) along the up vector. Seen 0xffffffff

fields.name: darkSwitchOut
fields.note: set to 1 while the light is out, 0 while lit. Seen 126

visual.detail: Draws the placement glist tinted by a psiLight's state. psiLight_Create returns 0 on Xbox, so on Xbox it is permanently lit (tint 255, no smoke). Only one placement (SnowBlind 0x07000029, glist 'Fuse boxs FX', 0 tris) - nothing visible.
Draws the placement glist only while the camera is on its back side: hidden when dot(dir row, pos - camera) < 0 (OneSided_Update 0xdb430). Occurs in no level.

255.name: unknown255
255.call: none: 255 > 254 -> the switch's range check jumps to the exit (0xa5c3f)

visual.detail: No-op. 7 placements, all at pos (0,0,0), no keys, glists 'Unnamed' (empty, inverted 9999999 bbox; 0700000c/0d, 07000001 pack 010000a2), 'A1blockingpolys' (8 tris) and Elevator_Door_Slide_A/B (07000014) - unused editor leftovers. Skip.
No-op. 1 placement (HendersonA pack 010000f3, origin): glist 0x0200063f 'AI_ViewCone' (0 tris, 40x2x20 bbox) - an editor gizmo. Skip.
No-op. 1 placement (HendersonA pack 010000f3, origin): glist 0x02000640 'AI_ViewDist' (0 tris) - editor gizmo. Skip.
